1. Transcript

This bag fits as a personal item on every airline I've flown. I packed it for a weekend trip and didn't even need a carry-on. The details are actually really nice and it holds way more than I expected. I even used it as my personal item on a flight and everything fit. It's a little big for daily errands though, so I might get the smaller one too.

Imagine a bag that only gets better with age, chic and cool at the same time, an everyday bag that looks expensive. I wanted something I could use every day but still looks put together. The details are actually really nice and it holds way more than I expected. I even used it as my personal item on a flight and everything fit. It's a little big for daily errands though, so I might get the smaller one too.

3. Transcript

Imagine a bag that only gets better with age. People always ask if this bag is too big, but honestly, it's the perfect everyday size. I fit my laptop right here, my water bottle, and even a jacket with no problem. This is the Ponte Arts Backpack by Ziti Peric, and this is the small size. The canvas is water repellent, and the leather details age really nicely the more you use it. It's one of those bags that actually looks better over time. Ponte de Arts Backpack, link below. Ponte de Arts Backpack, link below.

   - Usage: 13 ads
   - Total impressions: 110,386
   - Longest running: 129 days
   - First/last used: 2026-03-07 → 2026-06-08
   - Sample ad: facebook_2725580001158975 | Media URL: https://medias.trendtrack.io/facebook/video/589df4703c8bb76b211bbfeb00e08750c69dd75d52465df17f9d1718e2161b06.mp4

4. Transcript

I spent six years buying bags that were almost right and then I found this one. Every bag was either beautiful but useless or practical but ugly. Then I found Zidi Paris, a family atelier. Three generations. My keys, my phone, my wallet. The search is over. Zidi Paris, Pont des Arts, link below.

   - Usage: 11 ads
   - Total impressions: 74,588
   - Longest running: 137 days
   - First/last used: 2026-04-02 → 2026-06-08
   - Sample ad: facebook_1319237506966945 | Media URL: https://medias.trendtrack.io/facebook/video/b5f0b2cf66a1db96b041b20ef5c7750ead01b141c5de2c5a1ea677c94daf6c7e.mp4

5. Transcript

Okay, if you travel at all, even just a couple times a year, I need to show you this. I used to check a bag for every trip because I could never fit everything into something that also looked good. My old backpack held everything, but it looked like I was going camping. My nice bags held nothing. This is the Ponte Arts backpack from ZD Paris. It fits under the seat in front of you on basically every airline I've taken it on, but it lapped like a backpack. It looks like a bag. It doesn't look apartment, multiple pockets, adjustable straps, and it's water repellent. I packed it for a four-day trip, and I didn't check anything. This is the Ponte Arts backpack from ZD Paris. It fits under the seat in front of you on basically every airline I've taken it on. I've taken it to three cities in the last two months. I get compliments on it constantly. People always ask if it's a designer bag. It's designed in Paris. It comes in a bunch of colors, and it's genuinely a fraction of what you'd pay for something that looks like this. If you're tired of paying for checked bags or just want one bag that does everything, go look at ZD Paris. Link is right there.

   - Usage: 10 ads

6. Transcript

You only need five shoes in your rotation. Something for every day, something skinny, something dressy, something chunky, and something special. That's all you need.
